svg.title: Amrita: active eastern reservation and castle-centred marker trial
svg.desc: Same-scale plan comparison. The trial changes only the Amrita centre and label and fails four current rules. No depth or full ruin footprint is established.

g.text: Amrita: a nested place needs more than a moved pin
Canonical source534d07ad · same plan scale · exact trial centre is our interpretation · no depth assigned
Active eastern game reservation
Existing road end(3740,-500)
509.90-block centre separation
Castle-centred marker-only trial
Existing road end(3740,-500)
0-block separation; overlapping discs
Four measured default-check failures in the marker-only trial
1. Castle centre is outside the current mountain/hill polygons required for a carve site.
2. Separate-site spacing rejects overlapping r90/r63 reservations with margin48.
3. The existing Jistav road end loses its registered destination:361 blocks beyond the nearest site disc.
4. The fixed Amrita-east-of-castle relation still requires350–700 blocks.
Source relationship: ancient Amrita beneath the castle. Exact centre, depth and initial access remain unverified.
Choose nested castle-linked geography with technical redesign, or retain the eastern reservation as a server deviation.
The trial remains inactive; nested geometry, the road destination and registration require coordinated technical design.
